result.topic_en: A draft of a letter to a professor about the wording (translation) of the last sentence of a prize question on the theory of fluid motion using Lagrangian equations.
result.transcription:
Hochverehrter Herr Professor

[-Die Hin-]Uebersetzung [-Fassung-][?] des letzten Satzes der Preisfrage:
Itaque postulat Ordo
theoriam motus fluidorum aequationibus Lagrangianis

[-...-]

items.quote:
Itaque postulat Ordo
theoriam motus fluidorum aequationibus Lagrangianis
items.english: Therefore the Faculty demands the theory of the motion of fluids by means of the Lagrangian equations
